note:
Ade: Agent Bunny — SR/Iron/Supporter/Burst II (NOT `ade`, AR/Wind). Board: 0.964 COLD on 1 graded comp. Kit-faithfulness: every line is pinned green vs shipped and red vs its nearest-wrong counterfactual in a 22-test spec (scripts/tests/units/ade-agent-bunny.test.ts). The kit carries no heal, shield, DEF, HP, hit-rate, reload or recurring-damage lines, so most of the standard trap list does not apply to her; what is unmeasured is the full-charge proxy, the Spy-Lens ramp and the SR cadence tuple, all ⚑ below.
S1 block 1: allies casterAtkPct 15.2 for 5s on her full-charge landings. There is no full-charge trigger in the type system, so this rides a `shotFired` PROXY ⚑1 — every SR trigger pull is assumed to be a landed full-charge hit within effective range. The range condition is assumed always-true, since the engine force-sets noRange.
S1 block 2 — Spy Lens (self Minimum Effective Range ▲4.44%, 10 stacks, 5s) — is an inert range stat under the engine's universal noRange, so it is unmodeled as a BUFF. Its STACK COUNT is not inert, though: it gates S2 block 2, which is why the gate is encoded as a hit count rather than dropped with it.
S2 block 1: allies pierceDamagePct 18.36 for 5s on full-charge, same shotFired proxy. Kept even though pierceDamagePct only feeds Damage Up for pierce-TAGGED attackers — she is one herself once Spy Lens maxes, so her own 18.36 and her burst's 10.13 self-feed.
S2 block 2 ('only if Spy Lens is at max stacks': Gains Pierce continuous + ATK ▲16% continuous) is a STEP, not a passive: both the duration-less gainPierce and the self atkPct 16 ride a hitCount:10 trigger — the 10th full-charge hit, ~16s in at ~1.37s per full charge including one reload — and stay on thereafter. Encoding the Pierce as a duration-less `gainPierce` effect rather than a top-level hasPierce flag is what makes the step expressible at all: a boolean flag cannot be gated, and would tag her from frame 0.
BURST (burstCast, B2, cd 20): allies attackDamagePct 55.04 + pierceDamagePct 10.13 for 10s. The self Minimum Effective Range ▲55.56% is an inert range stat → unmodeled; range buffs change the effective-range BAND, not shots fired, so there is no shot-count channel for it to move.
⚑1 FULL-CHARGE PROXY: every trigger pull is assumed a landed full charge within range. Unmeasured.
⚑2 SPY-LENS RAMP: count:10 rests on 1 stack per full-charge hit plus the ⚑3 cadence, giving a ~15-16s onset. It is then held, because re-application refresh keeps stacks alive across the 2.35s reload (< the 5s stack duration) — standard NIKKE stack-refresh, ASSUMED. If instead each stack expires 5s after ITS OWN application, stacks would plateau around 3-5 and the gate would never open at all, which is the counterfactual worth ruling out first.
⚑3 CADENCE TUPLE: chargeFrames 60 + the default 22f bolt gap (noBoltRecovery is NOT set — it is never set unmeasured) + reloadFrames 141 + ammo 6 → ~1.37s per shot, ~10.6s per mag cycle. All datamine defaults. Recipe for all three: a focus video giving rounds/min, the reload gap, autofire behaviour, and a direct read of whether Spy Lens stacks refresh or expire individually.

skill1: Spy Lens: Minimum Effective Range ▲ 4.44%, stacks up to 10 time(s) and lasts for 5 sec.

caveats: skill1: the team ATK grant (15.2% of caster ATK) is keyed to a shotFired proxy for 'landing Full Charge attacks within effective range' — it assumes every trigger pull is a landed full charge (⚑ unmeasured)
skill2: the team Pierce Damage grant (18.36%) rides the same shotFired full-charge proxy (⚑ unmeasured)

skill2: 'Spy Lens at max stacks' gates BOTH the ATK ▲16% and the Pierce TAG, and both are encoded as a step on hitCount:10 (the 10th full-charge hit, ~16s including one reload), continuous thereafter. The Pierce is a duration-less `gainPierce` effect rather than a top-level hasPierce flag precisely so it CAN be step-gated — her own 18.36 + 10.13 Pierce-Damage self-feed and any teammate pierce buffs go live only once Spy Lens maxes, not from t=0. ⚑ count:10 rests on 1 stack per full charge plus the ⚑ SR cadence, and on stacks REFRESHING rather than expiring individually — per-stack 5s expiry would plateau stacks at ~3-5 and the gate would never open.
cadence: the SR bolt gap (22f), chargeFrames 60 and reloadFrames 141 are datamine defaults — verify autofire, rounds-per-minute and the reload gap from video (⚑ unmeasured)
